claim: Reconstruction-based anomaly detection was weak under the evaluated SGCC formulation
evidence_based_frozen_wording: FC, CNN, and LSTM test ROC-AUC values were approximately 0.56 with low AP/F1 under the evaluated reconstruction protocols.

claim: Supervised learning revealed usable theft-discrimination signal
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 13 supervised window models materially exceeded reconstruction discrimination, including customer ROC-AUC/AP 0.702314/0.219317 on the historically accessed test cohort.

claim: Behavioural summaries improved over raw window values
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 14 summary-only HGB improved customer ROC-AUC/AP over raw-only by 0.020741/0.020351 on historical validation.

claim: Frozen FC reconstruction or latent features provided complementary value
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 15 hybrid deltas were negligible and uncertain; the FC branch was rejected.

claim: Direct customer behavioural modelling substantially improved discrimination
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 16 direct FULL_48 HGB improved ROC-AUC/AP over the frozen window baseline by 0.054513/0.114958 with paired intervals excluding zero.

claim: The customer-level result replicated under the Stage 17 development split
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 17B reproduced strong DEV_VAL ROC-AUC/AP 0.788831/0.359795 under DEV_TRAIN/DEV_VAL governance.

claim: FULL_48 HGB strongly confirmed on CONFIRMATION
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 17C recorded ROC-AUC/AP 0.789084/0.379058 and Decision A strong confirmation.

claim: Performance was robust across history length
evidence_based_frozen_wording: All pre-specified Stage 18 history strata retained useful ranking with ROC-AUC 0.766-0.801.

claim: Performance was equally strong across consumption levels
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 18 found consumption ROC-AUC from 0.714 to 0.832 and material between-group variation.

claim: Low-consumption customers showed an operating-point limitation
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 18 low-consumption recall was 0.172 at the frozen global threshold.

claim: Consumption level alone explains discrimination
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 19 found level/distribution conditionally important, but non-level families retained useful ROC-AUC/AP 0.763537/0.325818.

claim: Non-level behavioural information contributes useful signal
evidence_based_frozen_wording: The five non-level families collectively retained useful discrimination and several had nonzero conditional/permutation contributions.

claim: Customer multiplicity explains the direct-customer advantage
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 20B customer balancing produced small deltas with both paired intervals crossing zero.

claim: Probability aggregation explains the direct-customer advantage
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Q90 improved AP in both window HGB arms, but ROC-AUC evidence was uncertain and the complete pre-registered explanation criterion failed.

claim: Customer-level loss placement explains the direct-customer advantage
evidence_based_frozen_wording: C_LOGIT minus W_LOGIT was small and both paired primary intervals included zero.

claim: Propagated temporal labels are proven noisy
evidence_based_frozen_wording: SGCC provides no theft-event timing; temporal instance-label noise cannot be identified.

claim: Strong boosting classifier choice materially determines the result
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 21 found HGB and LightGBM practically/statistically close and no material ensemble gain.

claim: Correlation-redundant features can safely be removed
evidence_based_frozen_wording: Stage 22's label-free 26-feature subset materially reduced both primary metrics.

claim: GAN is necessary
evidence_based_frozen_wording: No committed evidence establishes need or likely benefit from GAN augmentation.

claim: SMOTE is necessary
evidence_based_frozen_wording: No committed evidence establishes need; primary results use unweighted training without resampling.

claim: AMP is state of the art
evidence_based_frozen_wording: No protocol-equivalent literature benchmark supports a state-of-the-art claim.

claim: AMP externally generalizes beyond SGCC
evidence_based_frozen_wording: All evidence is internal to SGCC; no external dataset evaluation exists.
